::: {#thm-kl-normal}

#### KL divergence from the standard normal

For $\mu \in \reals$ and $\sigma > 0$,

$$
\kldivf{\dNf{\mu, \sigma^2}}{\dNf{0, 1}} = \frac{1}{2} \paren{\mu^2 + \sigma^2 - 1 - \logf{\sigma^2}}
$$

@kingma2014auto derive it in their appendix B.

:::

::: proof
By @sol-kl-normal.
:::
